Germany Wins Men's Hockey World Cup, Argentina Takes Women's Title

Germany has won the Men's Hockey World Cup, defeating Spain in the final match. The sole goal of the game was scored by Michel Struthof for Germany. In the Women's Hockey World Cup 2026, Argentina secured the title by beating nine-time champions the Netherlands 3-1. German defenders and goalkeeper were noted for their performance against Spanish attacks in the men's final.
